requirements.name: Authentication and role-based access control
requirements.priority_reason: Operational security, auditability and local administrative ease were emphasized repeatedly; ease of role administration and flexible access groups are essential for day-to-day operations.
requirements.append_explanation: Implementers shall implement and document user rights and privileges using security groups and/or roles; the system shall support assignment of those security groups/roles at the granularity of individual users, workgroups and arbitrary staff groups so administrators can target permissions to operational groupings. Role/permission artifacts (role definitions, group assignments and permission mappings) shall be exportable/importable as part of the migration/export/import mechanisms required elsewhere in this specification so role definitions and assignments can be moved between development, training and production environments and reproduced during deployments.

requirements.name: Canned, on-demand and open-template report interfaces
requirements.priority_reason: Stakeholders asked for distinct modes (canned, on-demand, open-template) to cover common and ad-hoc needs; canned/pre-defined board reports were repeatedly requested for governance and external consumption.
requirements.append_explanation: The canned-templates/quick-access UI shall display a hover-over descriptive pop-up for each canned report/template title containing a human-readable description of the report so users can discover what each template produces before running it. The quick-access designer shall include a field-selection affordance (for example checkboxes or similar 'check off' controls) enabling users to select arbitrary report fields or display sections to include in a run. The scheduling UI for canned or quick-access reports shall explicitly support the cadences: Run ASAP, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly and Yearly.
